text: 摩根士丹利周二发布的报告称，宁德时代周五将发布二季度业绩，有望超过公司指引以及该行的预估（分别为净利润220亿元与230亿元人民币），对未来业绩的指引也将强劲。近期接触的许多投资者表示，希望从交易过于拥挤的AI板块适度分散配置，转向基本面扎实、此前表现相对落后的优质公司。宁德时代明年增长前景预计依然强劲。柴油车电动化、储能超级周期的多重驱动力，以及钠离子电池产品周期启动，都将继续支撑公司增长。维持对宁德时代“增持”评级。
text_en: Morgan Stanley report Tuesday said CATL will release Q2 results Friday, likely exceeding guidance and the bank's estimates (net profit RMB 22 billion and RMB 23 billion respectively), with strong future guidance. Many investors recently contacted expressed desire to diversify from crowded AI trades to quality companies with solid fundamentals and lagging performance. CATL's growth outlook for next year remains strong. Diesel vehicle electrification, energy storage super-cycle, and sodium-ion battery product cycle launch will continue supporting growth. Maintain 'overweight' rating on CATL.
